expectations.H1: Expected: mean discounted frozen-policy return for strong-feedback training exceeds random training in the recorded/baseline cell, averaged across five methods and three matched dataset/training replicates. This is descriptive; collector labels do not establish the result.
expectations.H2: Expected: the mean paired discounted-return difference strong-current minus recorded is negative, averaged across all 60 frozen policies and four dynamics scenarios, with five paired episodes per cell. This need not hold for every policy or replicate.
expectations.H3: No directional prediction is registered for actuator attenuation or stochastic disturbances.
expectations.selection: Final checkpoint only; no online simulator selection, no online parameter updates, no hyperparameter search.
expectations.scope: Scenario families were inspected during development; fresh episode seeds do not establish unseen-task generalization. Three dataset/training replicates limit uncertainty resolution.
